Frequently Asked Questions
Frequently Asked Questions
Q1. What is a BIS licence?
Licence means a licence granted under Section 13 of BIS Act 2016 to use a specified Standard Mark in relation to any goods or article which conforms to a standard.
Q2. I am a manufacturer of a product and I am interested in applying for BIS product certification licenses. However, I am not aware of the corresponding Indian Standard against which I can apply for BIS Certification Marks Licence?
You can search for the Indian Standard against a product at the URL:https://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/bisconnect/knowyourstandards/indian_standards/isdetailsIf you cannot find the relevant Indian Standard, send a query to concerned technical department of BIS athttps://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/bisconnect/dgdashboard/committee_sso/
Q3. I am not aware how to get a BIS Certification Marks licence for Low voltage switchgears and controlgears for the products notified under the EEQCO. How can I apply for BIS Certification for these products?
The procedure of obtaining BIS Certification Marks licence for Low voltage switchgear and controlgears product notified under the EEQCO is provided in the guidance document‘Guidelines for Grant of Licence (GoL) as per the conformity assessment Scheme – X of Schedule – II of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018’and steps for applying for licence on Manakonline is given in‘Guidance on steps to be followed for grant of licence under scheme – X for new applicants’dated 10.08.2023. You may also refer to theProduct specific guidelinesas notified by BIS from time to time.
Q4. What are the essential requirements to be possessed by a manufacture for applying to BIS for obtaining licence?
For obtaining BIS Certification Marks Licence, the manufacturer must have the requisite manufacturing infrastructure, appropriate in-process controls and quality control, testing capabilities for the product as per relevant Indian Standard (IS) against which the manufacturer wants to apply licence. The product shall also conform to all requirements laid down in the ISs.
Q5. Can I submit one application for same product being manufactured at different factory locations?
No, separate application for each factory location is required to be submitted, even if the product and Indian Standards are same.
Q6. For which products, the BIS licence is compulsory? Or I am manufacturing a product.Is it compulsory to get BIS licence for my product?
Products are brought under compulsory certification by the Central Government under the provision of BIS Act, 2016 or other Acts. Detail of products which are covered under compulsory BIS certification is available athttps://www.bis.gov.in/product-certification/products-under-compulsory- certification/If your product is in this list, it is compulsory for you to get a BIS licence for it.
Q7. What is a Quality Control Order?
BIS certification scheme is basically voluntary in nature. However, for a number of products, compliance to Indian Standards is made compulsory by the Central Government under various considerations viz. public interest, protection of human, animal or plant health, safety of environment, prevention of unfair trade practices and national security.For all such products, the Central Government directs mandatory use of Standard Mark under a Licence from BIS through issuance of Quality Control Orders (QCOs) in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 16 read in conjunction with section 17 and subsection (3) of section 25 of the BIS Act, 2016.After the date of commencement of the QCO, no person shall manufacture, import, distribute, sell, hire, lease, store or exhibit for sale any product(s) covered under the QCO without the Standard Mark (e.g. the ISI Mark).List of all products under compulsory BIS certification along with the QCOs and their amendments is available on BIS websitewww.bis.gov.inunder Conformity Assessment>Product Certification>“Products under Compulsory Certification”.For more information on QCOs, please refer theguidance document on QCOspublished by BIS on itswebsite www.bis.gov.in.
Q8. What are the products covered under the scope of the Electrical Equipment (Quality Control) Order, 2020?
Eight categories of Low – Voltage switchgear and controlgear product. such as Circuit – Breakers, switches, disconnectors, switch disconnectors, etc. as described in column 2 of the table of the EEQCO and subsequent amendments made from time to time are covered in theElectrical Equipment (Quality Control) Order, 2020.
Q9. How can I access the Indian Standards referred under the QCO?
Indian Standards can be accessed from BIS website www.bis.gov.in under the tab “Standards>Download Indian Standards” which will direct you to the Standards BIS portal:https://standardsbis.bsbedge.com/You can register on this portal and then login to download Indian Standards for free. International (ISO/IEC etc.) standards adopted by BIS can also be downloaded on payment.
Q10. My company is sourcing products covered under the QCOs from a foreign manufacturer. Can foreign manufacturers also get BIS certification?
Yes, foreign manufacturers can also get BIS certification. BIS grants licence to foreign manufacturers under the “Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)”. Details including the application process, forms etc are available BIS websitewww.bis.gov.inunder Conformity Assessment>FMCS.
Q11. How BIS grants the licence?
The Bureau grants the licence based on successful assessment of the manufacturing infrastructure, in-process controls and quality controls, testing capabilities of the manufacturer through a visit to its manufacturing premises. Conformity of the product to the relevant standard(s) is also established through third party laboratory testing or testing in the manufacturing premises or a combination of both.
Q12. Our product conforms to requirement of Indian Standard mentioned in the EEQCO and is certified against the International Standard. Will the same test certificate be acceptabe?
No, you will require to an obtain a BIS license under Scheme-X of Schedule–II to the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations for all the products mentioned in the above Quality Control Order (EEQCO).
Q13. My company owns several manufacturing units spread across various locations. Do I need to obtain BIS certification for all these units?
Yes, separate certification (licence) needs to be obtained for each manufacturing premises (manufacturing premise(s) means the premises, either owned by the applicant or otherwise, where a part of the manufacturing activity takes place and includes the premises where the final manufacturing activity is carried out and where Standard Mark is to be used or applied).
Q14. In my manufacturing unit, I make different types of low voltage switchgear products. Do I need to take one licence for the unit or separate licences for each of the products? Do I also need to take separate licences for each of the different varieties of the same low voltage swtichgear products being produced?
BIS grants separate licences for each product according to the Indian Standard. For example, if both the AC Circuit – Breakers (as per IS/IEC 60947-2) and Isolators [(switches, disconnectors, switch disconnectors and fuse – Combination units) as per IS/IEC 60947-3] are being manufactured in the same unit, then that unit has to obtain two separate licences for each of these products/Indian Standard.
However, a single licence is granted for different varieties of a product and the licence is granted based on the guidelines applicable for that product. Please refer the product manuals (Scope of licence and grouping guidelines) for more information related to specific products.https://www.bis.gov.in/product- certification/product-specific-information-2/product-manualsmk.
Q15. I am an importer/ dealer/retailer/wholesaler/distributor of the products covered under the QCO. Do I also need to take BIS certification Licence?
No, BIS issues licence only to manufacturing units and not to dealers /importers /retailers/wholesalers /distributors.
However, dealers /importers/retailers/wholesalers/distributors shall ensure that the products covered under EEQCOs are of BIS certified material and are to be sourced only from manufacturing unit holding a valid BIS licence.
Q16. Where can I find the list of labs established and recognized by BIS for testing these products?
The list of labs recognised for testing all the products including the products notified under the EEQCO can be accessed from our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) portal i.e.lims.bis.gov.in.
Q17. What is a Technical File?
Technical file comprises of documentation covering design, manufacture and operation of products to the extent applicable and necessary for demonstration of compliance of conformity. Technical file is to be submitted with the application. For more details, please see circular Ref: CMD- I/2:17:1 dated 02 June 2023 with Subject ‘Guidelines for Grant of Licence (GoL) as per the conformity assessment Scheme – X of Schedule – II of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018’. Any product specific requirements for the technical file are indicated in the Product Manual for the respecting Indian Standard. The Product Manual for any Indian Standard can be accessed fromhttps://www.bis.gov.in/product-certification/product-specific-information-2/product-manualsmk/
Q18. Can I submit application for grant of licence under Scheme –X without Technical File?
No, application for grant of licence under Scheme –X shall not be submitted without Technical file. Moreover, application received without complete Technical File may be processed for rejection.
Q19. Where can I test the product for establishing compliance?
The list of labs recognised for testing the products notified under the EEQCO can be accessed from our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) portal i.e. lims.bis.gov.in.
Q20. From where can a foreign manufacturer get his product tested for grant of licence for the products notified under the EEQCO?
Please see response to Q19 above.
Q21. How much fees do I need to pay in order to get BIS licence?
The applicant has to bear the cost of testing of the product. Further, the applicant also has to pay fee to BIS towards submission and processing of the application. Details of fee payable to BIS is available on BIS website under the following path:https://www.bis.gov.in/scheme-x-certification/fee/.
Q22. What are the conditions of BIS licence to use or apply a Standard Mark?
Conditions of BIS licence to use or apply a Standard Mark are as given in Regulation 6 of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
Q23. What is the validity of BIS product certification licence for the products notified under EEQCO?
The licence to use Standard Mark for the products notified under EEQCO shall initially be granted for not less than three years and upto six years.
Q24. Are Manufacturer(s) permitted to manufacture /produce Goods and articles without BIS Certification Marks under the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Amendment Order 2023 for export Business.
Products manufactured for exports are not covered under the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order. However, if the manufacturer wishes to mark his product with the Standard Mark for export purpose, he can mark it with Standard mark provided, the manufacturer shall have a valid BIS Licecne and  it  shall  comply  with  the  requirements  specified  in  the  relevant  Indian  Standards.
Q25. Whether Product testing is required to include all accessories?
The accessories supplied alongwith the CBs is to be tested.
Q26. For getting a licence for the products notified under the EEQCO, can I submit a combination of in-house test report and Test report issued by from outside lab for establishing conformity of the product?
Yes, a combination of test report issued by different BIS recognised labs can be submitted for establishing the conformity of the product. However, it shall be ensured that the complete sequence is tested at the same lab.
Q27. How to include an intermediate rating of the Product in the existing License of LV Switchgear if there is no Construction Break.
The procedure for Grant of licence for the varieties of LV Switchgear is as per the Grouping Guidelines notified by Ministry of Heavy Industries. As per the Grouping Guidelines, in each group, a circuit breaker with maximum current rating and maximum features satisfying all operational performance criteria shall be tested(https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/5-Series- Guidelines-for-Low-Voltage-Switchgear-and-Controlgear.pdf)to get the licence for the CBs tested and the CBs below the rated CBs tested in that group. In case any firm intends to get the intermediate ratings of CBs having no construction break in that group then the firm has to submit the Technical File excluding the Test Report of that variety alongwith the applicable fees. BIS will assess the technical file and if the Technical file is found satisfactory, BIS will issue endorsement to the licence for including that ratings of CBs in the scope of the licence.
Q28. How to include a variety / rating of the Product in the existing License of LV Switchgear if there is Construction Break.
The procedure for Grant of varieties for LV Switchgear is as per the Grouping Guidelines notified by Ministry of Heavy Industries. As per the Grouping Guidelines, a circuit breaker with maximum current rating and maximum features satisfying all operational performance criteria shall be tested(https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/5-Series-Guidelines-for-Low-Voltage- Switchgear-and-Controlgear.pdf)to get the licence for the CBs tested and the CBs below the rated CBs tested in that group. In case any firm intends to get the intermediate ratings of CBs having construction break in that group then the firm has to submit the Technical File including the Test Report of that variety alongwith the applicable fees. BIS will assess the technical file and if the Technical file is found satisfactory, BIS will issue endorsement to the licence for including that ratings of CBs in the scope of the licence.
Q29. Where can I put the BIS Standard Mark? Can I put it only on the package?
The Standard Mark is to be applied on the product as well as on the package If it is not possible to apply the Standard Mark on both product and package, then it is to be given on the test certificate.
Q30. I have a test report available with me for the applicable sequence as per standard since Jan 2023. Will they be considered for QCO application even if third Party Lab was not listed as approved BIS Lab the time of testing?
BIS accepts test reports issued from BIS recognised labs. However, the test report issued by the BIS recognised third party laboratory (prior to issuance of guidelines –https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/3-Guidelines-for-Grant-of-Licence.pdf )available with the applicant may also be utilised for submission as part of the product-compliance report. Provided such test report shall not be older than 1 year from the date of submission of application. For type tests, test report which are less than 5 years old from the date of submission of application may also be accepted. In case any product specific guidelines are issued on this matter, the same shall be followed.
Q31. If the test facility for testing a particular variety/rating is not available in any of the BIS recognised labs, how to proceed with BIS certification?
If the test facility for testing a particular variety/rating is not available at any of the BIS Recognised Labs, then manufacturer may approach the concerned ministry which has issued the QCO i.e. MHI in this case.
Q32. My product is used as spares and Accessories in other assemblies. Do I still have to take licence for my product?
BIS licence is mandatory for the products notified in the QCO even if the product is used as a spare/ accessory in other assemblies. In case of any exemption, the concerned Ministry may be contacted.
Q33. I manufacturer Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear products for various brand owners. Do I need to take separate licence for each brand, even if they are made in the same factory premises?
BIS grants licence based on product type/variety for a particular manufacturing location. However, manufacture shall declare the details about of brand name to BIS for information purposes only.
Q34. Whether Product testing is required to include all accessories?
Yes, all accessories shall be tested, as per Product Specific Guidelines for Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear.
Q35. Where can I find the list of Documents/reports required to be submitted for grant of licence under Scheme – X?
List of documents to be submitted at the time of Grant of licence/ change in scope of licence is given in the Product Manual for the product. The same is available on BIS website.
Q36. I manufacture Circuit-breakers for selectivity category A as well as Circuit-breaker for selectivity category B. Both the circuit-breakers are covered in different phases of the QCO. How do I get licence for both the varieties?
The timelines for mandatory BIS licence for circuit- breakers is clearly defined in the EEQCO based on the rating of the product and selectivity category.However, if a manufacturer wants to get BIS licence for his product with selectivity category B along with his BIS licence for selectivity category A, the same is permitted.
Q37. Can BIS grant any extension or exemption from the QCOs?
Any exemptions like non-applicability of the Order on specific product(s), product(s) meant for export, extension of the date of commencement of QCO etc. come under the purview of the Line Ministry (Regulator) who has issued the QCO i.e. Ministry of Heavy Industries in case of EEQCO. Wherever exemptions are permitted, these are clearly brought out in respective QCO itself such as exemption for products meant for export.
Q38. I manufacture CBs with multiple ratings of Rated Voltage (Ue) and Rated Short Circuit breaking capacity (Ics) as given in the table below. However, I have tested the CBs as per IS for rated voltage (Ue) 440V and at corresponding rated short circuit breaking capacity current (Ics) at BIS approved Lab so that I can get the licence for CBs having lower voltage ranges (Ue (380/415 or 220/240V)) as per the grouping guidelines notified by the MHI. However, I intent to mark the rated voltages (Ue) 500V, 525V or 660/690 V on the CBs as I am having test report issued by foreign labs for these ratings of CBs. Can I mark the CBs that are tested upto 440V at BIS approved Labs with the voltage ratings of 500V, 525V or 660/690V?
